_comment: Governed Agentic Companion -> agentic-SDLC governance hook. Drop this Stop-style command hook into a harness that supports a command-hook convention (AI-DLC, Claude Code, and similar). It runs the GAC governance gate over each completed response/artifact: exit 2 (BLOCK) on an absolute Tenet 1/3/6 violation, exit 0 (allow) otherwise. Set GAC_ENGINE_REPO to your governed-agentic-companion checkout. Fails open if GAC is not installed.
